deployment.actualRuntimeEnvironment: Wrangler explicit .env.production; .dev.vars is not the active credential loader

initialActivationFailure.cause: Build inherited umask 0002 and produced public wrangler.json mode 0664; the existing runtime-input validator rejected group-writable input.
initialActivationFailure.repair: Tightened owned public config to 0644 with unchanged bytes; build children now use umask 0022 and staging normalizes public config to 0644. Credential and certificate permissions were unchanged.

validation.nativeResponseSignatureVerification: Production createWechatNativePayment verifies timestamp, configured public key ID and RSA-SHA256 before accepting code_url.
validation.realPaymentPerformedBy: User, using WeChat on their device
validation.realSuccessNotification: wechat:TRANSACTION.SUCCESS persisted; matching provider transaction ID on completed purchase
validation.syntheticCoverage: Protocol RSA/AES-GCM verification, malformed/tampered notifications, merchant/AppID/amount/currency rejection, checkout configuration preflight and SQL entitlement/idempotency regressions are covered by the source website suite; synthetic cases are separate from the real purchase below.

limitations: Alipay collection-quota review is independent of this successful WeChat acceptance; this test does not establish Alipay paid acceptance.
No real duplicate-notification replay or refund was performed.
